signals.text: 3 open PM roles across 3 US offices

roles.title: Senior Product Manager – AI Ready Data (SeekrFlow)
roles.location: Austin, Texas, United States; Menlo Park, California, United States; Reston, Virginia, United States

bullets: Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for AI Ready Data capabilities across SeekrFlow
Develop a deep understanding of how enterprise data is utilized across AI workflows, including retrieval, fine-tuning, evaluation, and agent-based systems
Define product capabilities across UI, API, and SDK surfaces, ensuring consistency across SaaS and self-hosted deployments
Partner closely with engineering, design, and research teams to identify opportunities for new platform capabilities
Evaluate emerging techniques, experiments, and research investments and determine their applicability to customer problems

roles.title: Principal Product Manager, Model Training & Fine-Tuning
roles.location: Austin, Texas, United States; Menlo Park, California, United States; Reston, Virginia, United States

bullets: Supervised fine-tuning and instruction fine-tuning workflows
Preference optimization techniques such as DPO and RL-based approaches
Training job configuration, orchestration, monitoring, and troubleshooting

roles.title: Director of Product Management – Explainability & Contestability
roles.location: Austin, Texas, United States; Menlo Park, California, United States; Reston, Virginia, United States

bullets: Define and own the product strategy for explainability and contestability across SeekrFlow
Build and maintain a roadmap that improves how users understand, debug, and refine AI system behavior
Write clear product specifications that define features, workflows, and expected system behavior for engineering and design teams
Define product capabilities across UI, API, and SDK , ensuring consistency for both SaaS and self-hosted deployments
Partner with engineering and design to deliver intuitive workflows for diagnosing issues and improving outcomes
